canonical_title: Flight path response to pitch attitude

versions.title_at_revision: Flight path response to pitch attitude
versions.text:
Standard: The air vehicle's forward flight (greater than 45 KGS) vertical rate response does not lag the pitch attitude response by more than 45 degrees at all frequencies below 0.25 rad/s, unless pilot evaluation determines the air vehicle handling qualities are no worse than Level 2. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis to assess the forward flight vertical rate response as specified in MIL-DTL- 32742, Flight Path Control and Flight Path Response to Pitch Attitude (Frontside) paragraph for each air vehicle configuration and loading within the SFE. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the forward flight vertical rate response as specified in MIL-DTL-32742, Flight Path Control and Flight Path Response to Pitch Attitude (frontside) paragraph for each air vehicle configuration and loading within the SFE. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the forward flight vertical rate response as specified in MIL-DTL-32742, Flight Path Control and Flight Path Response to Pitch Attitude (Frontside) paragraph for selected combinations of air vehicle configuration and loading within the SFE.
